249256.name: Sofia Bulga
249256.description: She is a renowned adventurer and was the strongest adventurer registered to the guild, prior to [Tomoe](https://anilist.co/character/138138/Tomoe) and [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/138139/Mio) joining. She is a dragon slayer that received the rank of SSS in honor of defeating Lancer as a dragon and is given the title "Dragon Slayer" after that.

250490.name: Hinako Yaotose
250490.description:
A High school girl living a quiet life in a seaside town, but she feels somewhat detached from her friends during the summer months. She lost her family on a trip when she was six years old. She has a deep, logical, calm and introverted personality. Rarely, she attracts aggressive monsters to her, including sea monsters from the shore.

She seems to have signs of PTSD.

250641.name: Megami
250641.description:
The being that reincarnated Lugh Tuatha Dé into a different world to have him kill the hero.

~!She manipulated fate thus allowing Lugh, Maha, Tarte, and Dia to meet, with the latter three being destined to die if Lugh was never reincarnated.!~

255890.name: Matama Akoya
255890.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm
__Favorite Food:__ Sweet Rolled Omelettes
__Least Favorite Food:__ Coriander
__Recent Ambition:__ To Have A Video Of Her Singing Go Viral On Social Media

Matama is a cheerful girl. However, she is also quite narcissistic and very sensitive to criticism. She fears both [Lord Enorme](https://anilist.co/character/288448) and [Magia Baiser Utena](https://anilist.co/character/175746), finding them both similar in that they use sexual harassment as punishment. She is terrible at singing except when engaging in exhibitionism, a fact discovered when Utena made her perform in the nude on threat of [Nemo](https://anilist.co/character/255889) being harmed.

256378.name: Kongming Zhuge
256378.description:
He is the former Chancellor of Shu Han, well-known strategist of the Three Kingdoms Period (220 -280 AD). 

As his life reached its end at the Battle of the Wuzhong Plains, he wished on his deathbed to be reborn into a world where peace thrives. Thus, he is reborn to modern-day Tokyo, Japan.
